newsitem.title: PERU: Peru mulls salary rise for public sector workers.
newsitem.headline: Peru mulls salary rise for public sector workers.

text.p: The Peruvian government is mulling an above-inflation salary rise this month for public sector workers.
"We are studying the possibility that this rise could be above inflation for the current year," Economy Minister Jorge Camet said, according to Tuesday's edition of government daily El Peruano.
Cumulative inflation in Peru for the first 10 months of 1996 was 9.99 percent, while the annual figure is expected to reach about 12 percent.
Camet was confirming an earlier pledge by President Alberto Fujimori at the weekend that public sector workers would receive their long-sought raise this month.
